CancelC2paBucketSignTask.description_en: Resumes a paused or pausing batch C2PA content credential signing task for an OSS bucket
CancelC2paBucketSignTask.description_zh: 恢复已暂停或正在暂停的OSS Bucket批量C2PA内容凭证签名任务

CreateC2paBucketSignTask.description_en: Creates a C2PA content credential signing task for batch processing objects under a specified prefix in an OSS bucket
CreateC2paBucketSignTask.description_zh: 创建一个用于批量处理OSS Bucket内指定前缀下对象的C2PA内容凭证签名任务

CreateC2paSignTask.description_en: Creates a standard C2PA Content Credentials signing task for a single JPEG, PNG, or MP4 file
CreateC2paSignTask.description_zh: 为单个JPEG、PNG或MP4文件创建标准C2PA内容凭证签名任务

CreateImageDefectDetectionTask.description_en: Submits an image for defect detection and returns a task ID for querying results
CreateImageDefectDetectionTask.description_zh: 提交图片进行瑕疵检测，返回任务ID用于查询结果

CreateImageDetectionTask.description_en: Creates an asynchronous image tampering detection task and returns the task ID
CreateImageDetectionTask.description_zh: 用于创建异步图片篡改检测任务并返回任务ID

CreateImageIncomeTaxDetectionTask.description_en: Submits a personal income tax record screenshot for forgery detection and returns a task ID
CreateImageIncomeTaxDetectionTask.description_zh: 提交个人所得税记录截图进行伪造检测，返回任务ID

CreateImageTask.description_en: Generates images based on a provided text description and returns a task ID
CreateImageTask.description_zh: 根据提供的文字描述生成图片，并返回任务ID

CreateSensitiveScanTask.description_en: Creates an image sensitive information scan task and returns the task ID
CreateSensitiveScanTask.description_zh: 用于创建图片敏感信息扫描任务并返回任务ID

DetectAigcImage.description_en: Determines whether an image is AI-generated and returns detection labels with confidence scores
DetectAigcImage.description_zh: 判断图片是否由AI生成，并返回检测标签及置信度

DetectImageBasicInfo.description_en: Retrieves basic information about a specified image, such as the file name, format, size, and resolution
DetectImageBasicInfo.description_zh: 获取指定图片的文件名、格式、大小和分辨率等基本信息

GetC2paSignResult.description_en: Queries the status and result of a single-file or OSS Bucket batch C2PA signing task
GetC2paSignResult.description_zh: 查询单文件或OSS Bucket批量C2PA签名任务的状态和结果

GetImageDefectDetectionTaskResult.description_en: Queries the status and result of an image defect detection task, including the abnormality score and reason
GetImageDefectDetectionTaskResult.description_zh: 查询图片瑕疵检测任务的状态和结果，包括异常分数与原因

GetImageDetectionTaskResult.description_en: Queries the status and result of an image detection task created by CreateImageDetectionTask
GetImageDetectionTaskResult.description_zh: 查询通过CreateImageDetectionTask创建的图片检测任务的状态和结果

GetImageIncomeTaxDetectionTaskResult.description_en: Queries the status and list of abnormal items for an individual income tax screenshot detection task
GetImageIncomeTaxDetectionTaskResult.description_zh: 查询个税截图检测任务的状态和异常项列表

GetImageTaskResult.description_en: Queries the status and result of an asynchronous image generation task and retrieves the image download URL
GetImageTaskResult.description_zh: 查询异步图片生成任务的状态和结果，获取图片下载地址

GetSensitiveScanResult.description_en: Queries the status and result of a sensitive information scan task and returns the details of the sensitive data discovered during the scan
GetSensitiveScanResult.description_zh: 查询敏感信息扫描任务的状态和结果，返回扫描发现的敏感数据详情

PauseC2paBucketSignTask.description_en: Pauses the C2PA content credential batch signing task for a specified bucket
PauseC2paBucketSignTask.description_zh: 暂停指定Bucket的C2PA内容凭证批量签名任务

ResumeC2paBucketSignTask.description_en: Resumes a paused or pausing OSS Bucket batch C2PA content credential signing task
ResumeC2paBucketSignTask.description_zh: 恢复已暂停或正在暂停的OSS Bucket批量C2PA内容凭证签名任务

SignUserImage.description_en: Embeds a C2PA digital signature into a user-uploaded image and returns the download URL
SignUserImage.description_zh: 对用户上传的图片嵌入C2PA数字签名并返回下载地址

VerifyImageSignature.description_en: Verifies the C2PA digital signature in an image and returns related information
VerifyImageSignature.description_zh: 验证图片中的C2PA数字签名并返回相关信息
